steps.title: Analyze Parse Error in Create Student
steps.description: Identify that the current parsing implementation in BackendApi.java tries to parse fields directly from the root of the student record, and expects '_id' instead of 'id'.

steps.title: Fix Create Student Parsing Structure
steps.description: Refactor createStudent in BackendApi.java to correctly parse root.success, extract the nested record object, fetch the ID using key 'id' instead of '_id', and retrieve application fields from the nested data object.

steps.title: Fix Get Students Parsing Structure
steps.description: Refactor getStudents in BackendApi.java to extract each record's ID using key 'id' instead of '_id' and extract student fields (name, phone, className, rollNumber) from the nested data object inside the record.

steps.title: Verify Model Compatibility
steps.description: Verify Student.java matches the properties and constructor requirements after these changes.

steps.title: Building Student Management
steps.description: Reassemble and build the student management app with corrected parser logic.
